title: Route subtasks by model when using Seedance: use Gemini 3.5 Flash for creative…
content: Route subtasks by model when using Seedance: use Gemini 3.5 Flash for creative direction, Claude Sonnet for intent parsing, and Seedance for final video execution to maximize prompt faithfulness.
tips: Route subtasks by model when using Seedance: use Gemini 3.5 Flash for creative direction, Claude Sonnet for intent parsing, and Seedance for final video execution to maximize prompt faithfulness.

es.content:
---
Dirige las subtareas por modelo al usar Seedance: utiliza Gemini 3.5 Flash para la dirección creativa, Claude Sonnet para el análisis de intención, y Seedance para la ejecución final del video para maximizar la fidelidad al prompt.
---

fr.content: Routage des sous-tâches par modèle lors de l'utilisation de Seedance : utilisez Gemini 3.5 Flash pour la direction créative, Claude Sonnet pour l'analyse de l'intention, et Seedance pour l'exécution finale de la vidéo afin de maximiser la fidélité au prompt.

ja.content: Seedanceを使用する際のサブタスクのモデルによるルーティング：創造的な方向性にはGemini 3.5 Flashを、意図解析にはClaude Sonnetを、最終的なビデオ実行にはSeedanceを使用して、プロンプトの忠実性を最大化します。

ko.content: Seedance를 사용할 때 모델별로 하위 작업을 라우팅하세요: 창의적 방향에는 Gemini 3.5 Flash를, 의도 분석에는 Claude Sonnet을, 최종 비디오 실행에는 Seedance를 사용하여 프롬프트 충실도를 최대화하세요.

pt.content: Roteie subtarefas por modelo ao usar Seedance: use Gemini 3.5 Flash para direção criativa, Claude Sonnet para análise de intenção e Seedance para execução final do vídeo para maximizar a fidelidade ao prompt.

zh.content: 在使用Seedance时按模型分配子任务：使用Gemini 3.5 Flash进行创意指导，Claude Sonnet进行意图解析，Seedance进行最终视频执行，以最大化保持prompt的忠实度。
